why: A pattern at the confirmed tier that matches ordinary code costs every user a false alarm. Minified code can say var z = '-1' with no padding before it, and a project can set global.i to a word, a lone letter, three digits or another letter. None of these is the campaign's tag, so none is confirmed (ADR-0058). Where weak.txt's looser global.i signal matches, the file gets its review line, as before.

findings.match: mentions something the campaign also uses
